pages.text: Some tools need less XP per level than the default curve:$(br2)$(li) $(item)Sword$() — required XP ÷ $(#55FFFF)1.2$()$(br2)$(li) $(item)Bow$() — required XP ÷ $(#55FFFF)1.2$()$(br2)$(li) $(item)Hoe$() — required XP ÷ $(#55FFFF)5$()$(br2)$(li) $(item)Shield$() — required XP ÷ $(#55FFFF)4$()$(br2)Pickaxe, hammer, axe, shovel, armor, and other tools use the default pace.

Server admins can change these divisors in $(#55FFFF)config/tools_of_the_gods-common.toml$() under $()progression$():$(br2)swordXpPaceDivisor$(br2)hoeXpPaceDivisor$(br2)bowXpPaceDivisor$(br2)shieldXpPaceDivisor$(br2)The $(#55FFFF)Scholar$() trait still adds +10% / +20% XP on top of these values.
